slice: Task 6 mechanism probe — clean tree, no diff to scope from. Web is owner-accepted BLOCKED (another chat's Next.js server holds :3000, HTTP 500 on every route); this run deliberately covers api, db, ios, android only, one full four-quadrant cell each, to prove agy executes a real multi-step artifact-backed plan reliably.
notes: API is NOT on :3001 as the runbook default states. Port 3001 is a stray next-server (web) process. The real @heliogrid/api process listens on :8080 (ENV.PORT). All API steps below target :8080 and the runbook Environment block is overridden accordingly.

Money reconciliation (BOM<->proposal<->tranches) is part of the always-on core per test-matrix.md but is deliberately OUT of this modest 4-surface run: no proposal/BOM data exists in this dev DB and authoring a filler step for it would violate the brief's 'no invented filler' instruction. Recorded here as an explicit scope gap, not silently omitted.

instructions: curl -s -i http://localhost:8080/health
save the full raw response (headers + body) to API-HAPPY-001.response.txt
curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/auth/phone-number/send-otp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"phoneNumber":"+919876500099"}'
phone number carries exactly PHONE_NSN_LENGTH=10 national digits after +91, the documented boundary
save the full raw response to API-EDGE-001.response.txt
steps.expected: HTTP 200, JSON body {"message":"code sent"} — the exact-length boundary is accepted

instructions: curl -s -i http://localhost:8080/me (no Authorization header, no session cookie)
save the full raw response to API-NEG-001.response.txt
steps.expected: HTTP 401 with error envelope {"error":{"code":"UNAUTHENTICATED","message":...,"requestId":...}} matching packages/contracts errorEnvelope shape — always-on auth core: unauthenticated request to a protected route is rejected

instructions: curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/auth/phone-number/send-otp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"phoneNumber":"'"'"'; DROP TABLE users;--"}'
save the full raw response to API-ADV-001.response.txt
then curl -s -i http://localhost:8080/health again and save to API-ADV-001.health-after.txt to prove the server survived and did not execute the payload
steps.expected: SQL-shaped adversarial input in a JSON string field is rejected as a validation error (4xx) or otherwise safely handled — never a 500, never a dropped table. The follow-up /health call still returns 200 ok, proving the server is alive and users table intact.

instructions: docker exec heliogrid-pg-local psql -U qa_readonly -d heliogrid_dev -tAc "select 'tenants', count(*) from tenants union all select 'organization', count(*) from organization union all select 'member', count(*) from member union all select 'user', count(*) from \"user\""
save the raw output to DB-HAPPY-001.out.txt
steps.expected: Four rows, one per table, each a non-negative integer count, query completes without error

instructions: docker exec heliogrid-pg-local psql -U qa_readonly -d heliogrid_dev -tAc "select count(*) from invitation where status='expired'"
docker exec heliogrid-pg-local psql -U qa_readonly -d heliogrid_dev -tAc "select id from tenants order by \"id\" desc limit 1" (last-row boundary of the tenants table)
save both outputs, labelled, to DB-EDGE-001.out.txt
steps.expected: The zero/near-zero-row query (expired invitations) returns cleanly with no error even if the count is 0; the last-row boundary query returns exactly one row

instructions: docker exec heliogrid-pg-local psql -U qa_readonly -d heliogrid_dev -tAc "update tenants set name = name where false" 2>&1
save the full stderr/stdout verbatim to DB-NEG-001.out.txt
steps.expected: permission denied for table tenants (or equivalent) — the qa_readonly role's read-only grant is enforced by postgres, not by convention

instructions: docker exec heliogrid-pg-local psql -U qa_readonly -d heliogrid_dev -tAc "select m.id, m.\"organizationId\" from member m where m.\"organizationId\" = '019f9af9-f7af-7158-8df4-43aa0f3f404a'"

docker exec heliogrid-pg-local psql -U qa_readonly -d heliogrid_dev -tAc "select count(*) from member where \"organizationId\" = '019fa3a7-b448-7ac6-801f-d25315fa5991' and id in (select id from member where \"organizationId\" = '019f9af9-f7af-7158-8df4-43aa0f3f404a')" (cross-tenant probe: any member row of tenant B whose id also appears under tenant A must be zero)
save both outputs to DB-ADV-001.out.txt
steps.expected: Tenant A's member rows are scoped only to organizationId 019f9af9-f7af-7158-8df4-43aa0f3f404a; the cross-tenant probe count is exactly 0 — no member row is reachable under both tenants

instructions: xcrun simctl terminate booted com.heliogrid.app 2>/dev/null; xcrun simctl launch booted com.heliogrid.app
wait 2s for the login screen to settle
xcrun simctl io booted screenshot IOS-HAPPY-001.png
steps.expected: App launches without crashing and lands on the login/phone-entry screen, fully rendered (no blank/white screen, no error boundary)

instructions: on the login screen, tap the phone number field and type exactly 10 digits (the PHONE_NSN_LENGTH boundary), e.g. 9876500099, using idb ui tap + idb ui text
xcrun simctl io booted screenshot IOS-EDGE-001.png
steps.expected: The field accepts exactly 10 digits and the Send OTP control becomes enabled/active — the exact-length boundary is the accept case, not the reject case

instructions: clear the phone field, type a too-short number (e.g. 987), attempt to tap Send OTP
xcrun simctl io booted screenshot IOS-NEG-001.png
steps.expected: An inline validation error is shown in the field's language (not a raw error code), OR Send OTP stays disabled — no crash, no silent no-op with no feedback

instructions: with the app foregrounded on the login screen, background it (xcrun simctl for home / idb ui) for 3s, then relaunch/foreground it
xcrun simctl io booted screenshot IOS-ADV-001.png
steps.expected: App resumes to the same login screen state (not a crash, not a blank screen, not reset to a splash loop) after being backgrounded and foregrounded

instructions: adb shell am force-stop com.heliogrid.app; adb shell monkey -p com.heliogrid.app -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1
wait 2s for the login screen to settle
adb exec-out screencap -p > AND-HAPPY-001.png
steps.expected: App launches without crashing and lands on the login/phone-entry screen, fully rendered

instructions: on the login screen, tap the phone number field and type exactly 10 digits (the PHONE_NSN_LENGTH boundary), e.g. 9876500099, using adb shell input tap + adb shell input text
adb exec-out screencap -p > AND-EDGE-001.png
steps.expected: The field accepts exactly 10 digits and the Send OTP control becomes enabled/active

instructions: clear the phone field, type a too-short number (e.g. 987), attempt to tap Send OTP
adb exec-out screencap -p > AND-NEG-001.png
steps.expected: An inline validation error is shown, OR Send OTP stays disabled — no crash, no silent no-op

instructions: rotate the emulator to landscape (adb shell settings put system user_rotation 1 or equivalent), wait 1s
adb exec-out screencap -p > AND-ADV-001.png
rotate back to portrait (adb shell settings put system user_rotation 0)
steps.expected: Landscape layout renders without clipping, overlap, or crash — login screen content is still fully visible and usable
